parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed a project for a 54 m² apartment: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, a turnkey renovation, and decorating.
The project included the living room, bedroom, kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom, as well as built-in wardrobes, shelving, and storage systems.
The furniture for each area was custom-made to the dimensions of the rooms and designed together with the interior.

Before work began, a detailed cost estimate was prepared covering the renovation, finishing materials, furniture, and appliances. The studio managed the project from concept through renovation, furniture installation, and decorating.
The gallery features photorealistic 3D visualizations of the apartment.
